name: per_labellar_sugar
what: open-loop, brain only: labellar sugar drive, read out as the firing rate of the proboscis motor neuron MN9 (the neural proxy for proboscis extension; the body is not stepped)

harness.note: the brain as scripts/assay_pathways.py builds it: Registry(policy), profiles.apply, connectome.build, lif.default_params, electrical.build; a fresh lif.Network per trial seeded default_rng(seed). No body, no sensory model, no Q10 (25 degC); noise per profile

readout.note: rate over the whole trial, averaged over the readout cells, then over trials. MN9 cells whose male_cns_extra statusLabel says they are incompletely traced are dropped (F-DATA-3: MN9_R has 633 inputs vs MN9_L's 6,358), which leaves MN9_L

bar_source: the sugar gate of the calibration and class searches: sugar->MN9_L > 5 Hz at 100 Hz, mean of 10 trials (DECISIONS s8 calibration rule v3; scripts/search/class_search.py). A protocol bar for a qualitative behaviour (sugar evokes PER; Shiu et al. 2024 Fig 2), not a measured MN9 rate
reference_script: scripts/assay_pathways.py --assay sugar_mn9 --rates 100 --shuffles 0 --trials 10 --profile m10f0 (trials.csv readout_hz per trial)
evidence_status: spent: the gate was a fit target of the s8 calibration and s11 class searches, so this is a regression check, not held-out evidence
